free_tier.stated: '1 Week' is listed as Free in the package price table, and the page says 'Every package can be tested with a one-week free trial period ... without any obligation to pay or order'.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, ~750 KB by convention, so a 1 TiB month is roughly 1.4 million article fetches
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 4100 days retention, in the package feature list

egress.terms: No data transfer limit; unlimited speed on UNL

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Stacks as a quota-free secondary on the Omicron spool where account sharing is wanted; as a primary it is the same spool as Newshosting at a higher monthly price.

limits.value: Unlimited Mbps on UNL; Sunny 20 and Sunny 60 cap at 20 and 60 Mbit

limits_note: UNL: 1 week free, 1 month EUR 14.78, 3 months EUR 7.40/mo, 6 months EUR 7.01/mo, 12 months EUR 6.23/mo. Account sharing with family and friends is allowed. Payment methods per the vendor KB: credit cards, PayPal, SEPA Direct Debit, iDEAL, PaySafe Card and Bitcoin.
binding_note: Unlimited volume and unlimited speed, with account sharing allowed. At 1 TiB/month nothing in the vocabulary binds.

identity_cost.detail: The free week is delivered through a signup product named 'SunnyUNLAnnualRecurringWithTrial', which is an annual recurring subscription with a trial attached, so a payment method is captured at signup even though the first week is free. That is inferred from the product id, not observed at checkout.

reliability_note: Omicron spool. Account sharing is explicitly permitted, which is unusual and is the main reason this storefront exists next to the others.
confidence_note: Prices, retention, connections and sharing terms are on the package page read today. The card requirement for the trial is inferred from the product id and the recurring billing model.

evidence.proved: '1 Week Free'; EUR 14.78 1 month, EUR 6.23 12 months; 40 connections; 4100 days; 'Share your account with family and friends'
credit cards, PayPal, SEPA Direct Debit, iDEAL, PaySafe Card and Bitcoin

notes: Bitcoin is accepted, which matters where a card is the constraint, but the trial itself still runs through the annual recurring product.

extras.payment_methods: card, PayPal, SEPA, iDEAL, PaySafe Card, Bitcoin
